subject: Partial settlement from HelixData (EUR) — VAT classification & journal correction needed
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-05-29T09:14:00Z
Subject: HelixData partial payment posted to INV-4872 — need journal + VAT reclass

Hi team,

HelixData (HS-43219) submitted a partial settlement for invoice INV-4872 this morning. PaymentsOps attached their remittance (remittance_helix_20270529.csv). Key points:

- Invoice INV-4872 issued 2027-04-03 for GBP 42,000 (standard SaaS subscription, VAT-exempt per contract clause 4.2).
- Payment received today: EUR 23,450 (partial, net of bank fees).
- Our AR posting (system) has held EUR 23,450 against INV-4872 but currency/FX rounding left a GBP unapplied balance and a VAT liability tag was incorrectly set to "taxable" on the remittance mapping.

Customer insists the invoice is VAT-exempt; they provided a VAT registration excerpt in the attached vat-support-helix.zip. They expect remaining balance to be cleared within 30 days.

Request: can Finance post a journal to move the received payment into the suspense clearing account, apply FX reval to align GBP/ EUR balance, and correct the VAT classification for INV-4872 to exempt so we do not accrue VAT incorrectly? Also need updated AR aging entry and a note so Collections knows the expected paydown date.

Attachments: helix_inv_4872.pdf, remittance_helix_20270529.csv, vat-support-helix.zip

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Key Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-29T10:22:00Z
Subject: Re: HelixData partial payment posted to INV-4872 — need journal + VAT reclass

Thanks Soojin — forwarding to Marcus to action. A couple clarifying Qs before we post:

1) Which GL accounts should the suspense clearing and VAT reversal flow to? Our usual for EU partials is: Suspense AR (2301), FX reval (7050), and VAT accrual reversal (2415) if needed. Confirm?
2) Do we have the remittance bank trace id (in the CSV) mapped to the payment register? That will affect whether we create a contra entry or a straight re-allocation.

Marcus — can you pick this up and paste the draft journal below once you have lines? Laura, please mark the AR ticket as "partial settled — VAT under review" so Collections won't auto-escalate.

— Grace
Director, Revenue Operations

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-29T12:01:00Z
Subject: Re: HelixData partial payment posted to INV-4872 — need journal + VAT reclass

Got it. I pulled the remittance — bank trace REF-HELI-5521 is present in remittance_helix_20270529.csv. Preliminary plan:

- Create journal JNL-20270529-HELI:
  - Debit Suspense AR (2301) EUR 23,450
  - Credit Bank Clearing (1010) EUR 23,450
  - Run FX revaluation that posts to FX gain/loss (7050) to align GBP residual on INV-4872
  - If VAT was earlier posted to VAT accrual (2415) on this invoice, post reversal to 2415 GBP equivalent.

I need confirmation on VAT status before reversing accruals. Soojin — can Oliver (customer) confirm that HelixData is VAT-exempt for this transaction? Marta from Tax Partners is copied (external) — can you weigh in if we can rely on the VAT excerpt in the zip as sufficient support for reversal?

I will hold the journal in draft until we have confirmation; will attach draft JNL export here when ready.

Marcus
Senior Manager, Accounting Operations

From: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@helixdata.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, PaymentsOps <payments@helixdata.com>
Cc: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@taxpartners.eu>
Date: 2027-05-29T15:03:00Z
Subject: Re: HelixData partial payment posted to INV-4872 — need journal + VAT reclass

Hi Soojin / Marcus / Grace,

Confirmed — HelixData is non-taxable for SaaS under our EU grouping; the attachment includes the VAT registration and the intercompany declaration. The EUR payment reflects the bank's conversion on our side; we see the remaining GBP 8,120 outstanding on our end. We also confirm net-of-fees.

Apologies for not calling out the VAT-exempt status on remittance — we assumed the invoice terms made that clear. We have asked our PaymentsOps to include a note in future remittances.

If it helps, I can provide the bank P&L showing the currency conversion timestamp — let me know and I'll push it through.

Best,
Oliver Reed
Head of Finance Ops
HelixData

Update — posted journal and cleared suspense. Summary of work done: 

- Journal JNL-20270530-HELI posted 2027-05-30 16:03 UTC. Entries:
  - DR Suspense AR (2301) EUR 23,450
  - CR Bank Clearing (1010) EUR 23,450
  - Posted FX reval to FX gain/loss (7050) GBP 210.34 (to reconcile ledger with invoice currency)
  - Reversed VAT accrual (2415) GBP 0.00 (no VAT had been accrued at invoice creation; entry was a mis-tag only)

- AR record for INV-4872 now shows: Original GBP 42,000; Applied EUR 23,450 (converted); Outstanding GBP 8,119.66.
- Collections ticket CT-7291 updated: "Partial settled — customer provided VAT excerpt; payment schedule agreed. Next follow-up 2027-06-28."
- Attached: journal_export_JNL-20270530-HELI.csv (uploaded to Drive link).

Laura — please watch for the scheduled follow-up. Soojin — you can close your customer action item once Helix confirms the last payment.

Marcus
